name: Sanctus Familiar

bonuses.name: Cloaked by Shadows
bonuses.text: If this Threat is in cover or hidden by shadows it gains +2 Defence. Additionally, attacks that target this Threat from 12m or more away suffer a +2 DN penalty.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2 DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133).

abilities.name: Unquestioning Loyalty
abilities.text: When a Threat with the GENESTEALER CULT and PSYKER Keyword within 6m of this Threat is targeted by a ranged attack, this Threat may interpose themself as a reaction and become the new target for the attack.

note: Skills line printed 'SKILLS: : Default 4'. Size printed 'Small'.
